question: A, B and C can complete a task in 10, 15 and 18 days respectively. In how many days will all of them complete the same task working together?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the task in 10 days.

B can complete the task in 15 days.

C can complete the task in 18 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by all of them together in 1 day = Work done by A in 1 day + Work done by B in 1 day + Work done by C in 1 day

Work done by all of them together = 1 / (Work done by all of them together in 1 day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/10

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/15

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/18

Work done by all of them together in 1 day = 1/10 + 1/15 + 1/18
